<documents>
<document id="fees-schedule-premium-v2">
PremiumˆplanˆfeeˆscheduleˆHereˆisˆeveryˆfeeˆthatˆcanˆapplyˆtoˆaˆPremiumˆaccount,ˆeffectiveˆMarchˆ1,ˆ2026.ˆFeesˆareˆtakenˆfromˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆwhenˆthey'reˆchargedˆandˆshowˆupˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeedˆwithˆtheˆwordˆ"Fee".ˆ|ˆFeeˆ|ˆAmountˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆMonthlyˆfeeˆ|ˆ$15.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOut-of-networkˆATMˆwithdrawalˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆInternationalˆATMˆwithdrawalˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆForeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆ|ˆ0%ˆ|ˆ|ˆCardˆreplacementˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆExpeditedˆcardˆshippingˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆdomesticˆwireˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆinternationalˆwireˆ|ˆ$10.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆIncomingˆinternationalˆwireˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆCashˆdepositˆatˆaˆretailˆstoreˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ##ˆDetailsˆPremiumˆhasˆnoˆATMˆfeesˆfromˆus,ˆandˆweˆpayˆbackˆATMˆownerˆsurchargesˆupˆtoˆ$10.00ˆeachˆmonth.ˆNoˆplanˆhasˆoverdraftˆfees,ˆreturnedˆtransferˆfeesˆorˆinactivityˆfees.ˆTheˆmonthlyˆfeeˆisˆchargedˆonˆyourˆbillingˆdateˆandˆisn'tˆprorated.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="atm-surcharges">
ATMˆownerˆsurchargesˆandˆourˆfeesˆWhenˆyouˆuseˆanˆATMˆoutsideˆBrookLink,ˆupˆtoˆtwoˆdifferentˆchargesˆcanˆapply.ˆThey'reˆeasyˆtoˆmixˆup.ˆ##ˆTheˆATMˆowner'sˆsurchargeˆThisˆisˆsetˆbyˆwhoeverˆownsˆtheˆATM,ˆnotˆbyˆus.ˆTheˆATMˆshowsˆitˆonˆscreenˆbeforeˆyouˆconfirm,ˆandˆit'sˆaddedˆtoˆtheˆwithdrawalˆamount.ˆForˆexample,ˆifˆyouˆwithdrawˆcashˆandˆtheˆownerˆchargesˆaˆsurcharge,ˆoneˆtransactionˆforˆtheˆtotalˆappearsˆinˆyourˆactivity.ˆ##ˆTallowbrook'sˆout-of-networkˆfeeˆThisˆisˆourˆfee,ˆchargedˆasˆaˆseparateˆlineˆcalledˆ"Out-of-networkˆATMˆfee".ˆIt'sˆ$2.50ˆonˆBasicˆandˆonˆPlusˆafterˆyourˆfreeˆwithdrawals,ˆandˆfreeˆonˆPremium.ˆ##ˆPremiumˆsurchargeˆreimbursementˆPremiumˆpaysˆbackˆATMˆownerˆsurchargesˆupˆtoˆ$10.00ˆperˆcalendarˆmonth.ˆTheˆrefundˆisˆcreditedˆautomaticallyˆonˆtheˆfirstˆbusinessˆdayˆofˆtheˆnextˆmonth.ˆ##ˆAvoidingˆbothˆUseˆaˆBrookLinkˆATM.ˆTheyˆneverˆchargeˆaˆsurcharge,ˆandˆweˆneverˆchargeˆaˆfeeˆforˆthem.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="atm-fees-premium">
ATMˆfeesˆonˆPremiumˆHere'sˆwhatˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆcostˆonˆtheˆPremiumˆplan.ˆ|ˆATMˆ|ˆTallowbrookˆfeeˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆBrookLink,ˆinˆtheˆUSˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆAnyˆotherˆATMˆinˆtheˆUSˆ|ˆnoˆfeeˆ|ˆ|ˆATMsˆoutsideˆtheˆUSˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆPremiumˆalsoˆreimbursesˆATMˆownerˆsurchargesˆupˆtoˆ$10.00ˆeachˆcalendarˆmonth,ˆinˆtheˆUSˆandˆabroad.ˆ##ˆSurchargesˆATMˆownersˆoutsideˆBrookLinkˆcanˆaddˆtheirˆownˆsurchargeˆonˆtopˆofˆourˆfee.ˆTheˆATMˆshowsˆitˆonˆscreenˆbeforeˆyouˆconfirm.ˆ##ˆDailyˆlimitˆYouˆcanˆwithdrawˆupˆtoˆ$1,500ˆaˆdayˆonˆPremium.ˆ##ˆWhereˆfeesˆshowˆupˆAnyˆTallowbrookˆATMˆfeeˆappearsˆasˆitsˆownˆlineˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeed,ˆrightˆafterˆtheˆwithdrawal,ˆsoˆyouˆcanˆalwaysˆseeˆwhatˆyouˆpaidˆusˆandˆwhatˆtheˆATMˆownerˆcharged.ˆTheˆapp'sˆATMˆmapˆshowsˆtheˆnearestˆBrookLinkˆATMs.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: How much does Premium pay back for ATM surcharges?
